changelog:
adc-landscape-monitoring 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for continuous ADC landscape monitoring.
- Automatically generates downloadable HTML briefings on ADC R&D, clinical, patents, deals, and competitive events.
- Covers multi-source structured data (clinical, BD, patents, approvals, conferences) with strict module workflows and objective reporting rules.
- Includes powerful filtering, tagging, and summary features for trends and statistics across targets, companies, indications, and geography.
- Provides validated link generation and comprehensive FAQ troubleshooting for common issues.
